verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says Blaxel sandboxes run in microVMs or behind any other documented hard isolation boundary. The nearby security material covers adjacent controls (egress proxy and domain allowlists, a non-root user inside the sandbox, scoped tokens), not the compute isolation boundary between sandboxes and the user's systems. Those adjacent controls earn no credit under the partial-credit rule.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems
